place.name: Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Ridge Trail and Boardwalk
features.description: The half-mile Ridge Trail interpretive boardwalk, restroom, and pavilion have been closed since March 2, 2026 for boardwalk reconstruction; do not route here without checking reopening status.

details.positionQuality: Ridge Trail and interpretive boardwalk access on Chef Menteur Highway
details.coordinateSource: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service visitor directions and mapped trail data
details.imageAlt: Ridge Trail and Boardwalk at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Maxent Levee
features.description: Maxent Levee allows walking and bicycling through open refuge habitat from the Ridge Trail area, subject to gates, construction, weather, and seasonal rules.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed point on the Maxent Levee route near Ridge Trail
details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service access information
details.imageAlt: Maxent Levee at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Joe Madere Marsh
features.description: Joe Madere Marsh provides wetland observation and fishing access in remote exposed habitat where water, shade, restrooms, and mobile service cannot be assumed.

details.coordinateSource: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service published GPS coordinates
details.imageAlt: Joe Madere Marsh at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Highway 11 boat launch
features.description: The Highway 11 launch and small fishing pier access canals toward Lake Maisson and Lake Antoine; boating safety and Louisiana rules apply.

details.coordinateSource: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service published GPS coordinates
details.imageAlt: Highway 11 boat launch at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Irish Bayou boat launch
features.description: Irish Bayou access serves fishing and boating near the refuge edge; verify launch conditions, gates, weather, and exact navigation before departure.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed Irish Bayou access near the Highway 11 and I-10 refuge edge
details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service access directions
details.imageAlt: Irish Bayou boat launch at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Bayou Sauvage fishing areas
features.description: Fishing and crabbing are allowed in designated waters under current Louisiana and refuge rules, with seasonal restrictions outside the protection levee.

details.positionQuality: Crabbing Bridge Road fishing access at 30°9'14.5"N 89°51'25.9"W
details.coordinateSource: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service published GPS coordinates
details.imageAlt: Bayou Sauvage fishing areas at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Bayou Sauvage birding habitat
features.description: Marsh, forest, lagoon, and open-water habitats support alligators and abundant birds; observe from distance and never feed wildlife.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed marsh birding viewpoint near Ridge Trail
details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service visitor information
details.imageAlt: Bayou Sauvage birding habitat at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge

features.name: Hurricane Protection Levee access
features.description: Access outside the Hurricane Protection Levee is delayed until noon during teal season and November 1-January 31; posted gates always control.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed refuge access near the hurricane-protection levee
details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of federal refuge access and habitat maps
details.imageAlt: Hurricane Protection Levee access at Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge
